title: Scaling the uniform norm
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, real numbers $p,c$ with $p>0$, and a function $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$, the uniform $L^p$ quantity of $cf$ equals $|c|$ times the uniform $L^p$ quantity of $f$.
